facts.fact: Ooredoo's Capital Markets Day deck says its carrier-neutral data centre platform Syntys is active in Tunisia, with about 2 MW of current capacity and a 25% share of the Tunisian data centre market, offering colocation, cloud and AI hosting; no tier rating is given.

note: Deck dated 3 November 2025, used as as_of; no Tier III/IV claim or cloud region for Tunisia.
